references.name: river.jpg
references.observed: Close view shows pale stone arch rings, angular pier noses, a low parapet, and tall river spans transitioning to smaller floodplain arches. The existing weir and original river run beneath the bridge.

references.name: arches.jpg
references.observed: Wide oblique view shows the arches extending from the river across the floodplain toward the town. Model the full surviving crossing with a distinct transition in arch size.

references.interpretation: The continuous pale stone deck continues from the mapped named way across the town-side secondary way to the square. The bend over the Ergene and the far and near abutments match the combined road trace.
